reviews.title: Don’t get it if you have an iPhone 18 Pro Max
reviews.text: Just bought my new phone, went to use it, and it won’t open. Force closes. Deleted, re-downloaded, still doesn’t work. I’m glad I paid for the subscription so now I’m out of money.

reviews.title: Not working on IOS 27
reviews.text: Got the new iPhone 18 Pro running iOS 27 and the app no longer is working. When you click on it now it starts to open, nothing happens for awhile, then it closes. I even deleted it and reinstalled  it but still won’t open

reviews.title: They take money from your account and then only respond with AI
reviews.text: DO NOT USE! This company are a scam

reviews.title: Love hate relationship
reviews.text: I love this app but recently all it does is crash and freeze :(

reviews.title: No longer worth using!!!
reviews.text: When I first got this app yearsssss ago it was free and I had access to everything. I recently decided to start back using it and now I have to sign up to pay if I want to use all the features. I guess it’s time for me to delete it!

reviews.title: The apps is not working
reviews.text: Your company just charged me again for yearly. However this app cannot even open on my phone device. I request for full refund.  Thanks for your understanding.

reviews.title: Such a scam
reviews.text: This app is such a scam as soon as I went onto it and got signed in it wouldn’t let me save anything. It asks me to pay money before I can even save the photo. I tried to screenshot it but it came up with a picture of an owl which is not what I had edited at all. Warning do not get this app.

reviews.title: Shuts down
reviews.text: The app shuts down every time I try to do something. It used to be good and I loved it. Now I can’t use it. I’ve tried to contact support but I haven’t had any response.

reviews.title: Hasn’t opened in months
reviews.text: This app has not opened in MONTHS!!!! I still have months left in my paid premium subscription!  Reported multiple yikes with no action. So disappointed!!!!
